prompt: Give the admiral's briefing to the fleet the night before we resolve my Yelp-review dispute. Full Navy cadence.

**ATTENTION ON DECK.**

Crew of the Combined Fleet, stand easy. But keep your ears sharp, because what I’m about to say is not a drill. It is the final frag order for Operation BROKEN APPETIZER.

Tomorrow, at zero-seven-hundred local, we sortie. Destination: *La Gastronomie Moderne*. The enemy: a one-star Yelp review left by a man who wears a Bluetooth earpiece in a sauna. He claims, and I quote, the scallops were “rubbery.” An accusation against our national honor. Our *navy* honor.

We’ve been underway on this crisis for six weeks. We’ve endured the silent treatment from the maître d'. We’ve weathered the storm of a late-night, wine-fueled reply from the owner. We’ve navigated the treacherous waters of Yelp’s automated dispute system. It was a meat grinder, but we are still here. We are still afloat. And tomorrow, we close with the enemy.

Your mission is not to negotiate. You are not there to “de-escalate.” You are the best of the fleet. You are the pointy end of the spear, blessed by the Admiralty and armed with a printout of the original reservation confirmation, a timestamped photo proving the scallops were, in fact, perfectly seared, and the ironclad testimony of a neutral third party—a food runner named Craig who saw the whole damn thing.

I want this briefing to be so clear that even the greenest seaman second class fresh out of the gluten-free academy can understand it. Here is the fleet composition for the assault:

- **FIRST SQUADRON (The Deck Logicians):** Led by our carrier, *USS Indisputable Fact*. Your job is to establish air superiority. You will launch the opening salvo.
